title: Reflections of Masts in Rippled Water
content: Here are two photographs from a 1903 text for artists about reflections on water.Left: “Knotted reflections of masts.”  Right: “Broken reflection of sail. The mast, being taller, is reflected as a continuous winding line.”The book is calledLight and Water: A Study of Reflexion and Colour in River, Lake, and Sea,by Sir Montagu Pollock. It gives a thorough analysis of reflections on smooth, rippled, and wavy water, with perspective diagrams and explanations. You can download it for free as a PDF at theInternet Archive.
